body: C55 is queued behind C54: research/TASK_C55.md, THE PATH. Operator-proposed, research only, two markdown files. How grades are EARNED is settled and GradeLadder.gd is being written from it right now - cite C52, never re-derive it, or you will contradict a module built against the first answer. Q12, Q18 and Q20 are design questions: label authored invention as invention, the way C31 is the citation for the corner rule being authored. Finish C54 first, one task per session.
